scope: Activate exact-task read-only Vercel deployment inspection using existing encrypted owner OAuth and operational journal; no new credentials, consent, paid or mutation authority.
riskAnalysis: STRICT credentials, task permissions, deployment identity, revocation and immutable evidence. Future provider deployment write scope is not exposed by this GET-only gateway.

threatModel.assets: Encrypted Vercel token, owner/workspace identity, task grants and immutable evidence.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Owner HTTP/UI to persisted task grant; trusted broker to fixed provider GET and untrusted response; OAuth connection and Ops CAS are separate records.
threatModel.abuseCases: Forged task, stale deployment/source/origin, broad scopes, replay, revocation races, secret-bearing responses and stalled authorization/storage.
threatModel.mitigations: Fresh owner and task checks, AES-GCM exact AAD, exact three scopes and selected project, fixed GET, internal deadline, revalidation and strict sanitized receipt; no writes/retry.

rollback: Revert only Preview read activation source; centrally revoke affected grants and local connection before rollback, preserve original receipts, main/Production unchanged.

negativePaths.malformed-response: Strict field/finite diagnostic validators reject secrets and unsupported evidence.
negativePaths.stale-state: Exact task/source/release/origin/deployment/revision/fence binding at admission, transport and receipt.
negativePaths.concurrency: Existing CAS/idempotency prevents duplicate dispatch; explicit provider-specific revoke and emergency stop. Separate OAuth/Ops final checks do not imply atomic cross-record cancellation.
negativePaths.provider-failure: No automatic retry; unavailable evidence remains distinct from successful inspection.
negativePaths.partial-persistence: No optimistic UI success; durable readback and immutable audit remain authoritative.
negativePaths.cancellation: Abort tests cover stalled owner, Redis, task authorization, broker transport and lease revalidation; no late dispatch.
negativePaths.worker-interruption: No new worker is added. Existing interrupted-read grant revocation is exercised by real composed broker failure and emergency stop.
negativePaths.api-outage: Fixed GET failures become finite unavailable receipts; stalled requests remain bounded with no automatic retry.
negativePaths.authorization-denial: Fresh owner/task/scope and revocation checks at broker and dispatch; unauthorized owner API and CSRF requests deny before provider access.
negativePaths.spending-limit: This tool performs only two fixed read-only provider GETs, creates no model request, paid grant or spending reservation.
negativePaths.partial-execution: Revoke during configuration read prevents deployment GET and revokes the exact pending grant; completed historical evidence remains immutable.

defects.rootCause: Prepared Vercel adapter had no functional task-scoped encrypted credential broker and assumed provider expiry.
defects.detectionGap: Owner OAuth verified project identity but intentionally did not activate the agent tool.
defects.regression: Actual encrypted broker/service/adapter and guarded HTTP positives; exact scopes, ciphertext, timeout, cancellation, provider-specific revoke and receipt substitution negatives.
defects.historicalPrevention: Hosted exact-release read remains mandatory, no inference from owner OAuth alone.

defects.rootCause: Initial new broker did not bound stalled owner/storage awaits; multi-provider policy audit inherited GitHub default; revoked OAuth read could persist unavailable without interrupted grant cleanup.
defects.detectionGap: Independent Auditor/QA and new real composition tests exposed each before publication.
defects.regression: Stalled owner/Redis/task and lease checks, exact audit-provider events, revoke during configuration GET must block deployment dispatch and revoke grant.
defects.historicalPrevention: Review and test actual composed boundaries, not only isolated adapter counts.

proactiveReview.architecture: Extend existing gateway/operations and encrypted OAuth; no parallel task or authorization store.
proactiveReview.dependencies: Existing Vercel installation and three scopes, owner session/member/workspace policy, Redis CAS, provider configuration GET and deployment GET, actual VERCEL_DEPLOYMENT_ID.
proactiveReview.threats: Forged task, stale deployment/source/origin, broad scopes, replay, revocation races, secret-bearing responses and stalled authorization/storage.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Missing runtime deployment ID disables grant UI and denies dispatch. Deadline/provider/storage failures deny without retry; past provider requests cannot be recalled.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Revocation during configuration GET, stalled identity/storage/task, altered ciphertext/scopes/receipt/source, replay and emergency stop.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Auditor approves local read-only wiring; QA verifies corrected audit attribution and actual HTTP/UI tests. Hosted identity and latency still unverified.
proactiveReview.recovery: Exact-grant interruption revocation and independent owner cleanup; no permission restoration, credential rotation or paid fallback.
proactiveReview.readiness: Local provider-substituted tests only so far; freeze and run mandatory STRICT/Redis/CI/CodeQL, then genuine exact-release owner UI read and cleanup. No paid model authority.
